propositions: The Git version floor gate step hard-fails when .github/git-version-floor.txt is absent from the checked-out patchset tree, even though the workflow definition (which contains the step) comes from main.
Every open change branched before the gate merged receives the step without its data file and fails Verified, regardless of the change's content or intent.

The gate must skip with an explanatory log line when the floor file is absent from the tree under test, naming that the change predates the gate and enforcement re-applies on rebase and post-merge, rather than exiting with an error that sends authors searching for a file they never touched.
An under-floor git version must continue to fail with the full diagnostic (required version, installed version, upgrade path) when the floor file is present.
